title: THE UNDERCROFT FLOOR TEXT GROWS WITH THE SCREEN
why: Seen on the 4K Undercroft screenshot of 2026-10-07: THE UNDERCROFT title, the line under it (credits, XP, stash, runs) and the key footer over the belt were drawn at their 1080p size at every resolution, small specks at 4K while the station names and the belt grow with the screen. They now grow with the screen too; at 1080p nothing changes.
now: At 4K the Undercroft title, stats line and key footer are a readable size.

edits.anchor: ctx.shadowColor='rgba(4,6,9,.95)'; ctx.shadowBlur=4;   // v18.62: the halo, for the stats line too
edits.replacement:
ctx.save(); ctx.scale(_hhr,_hhr);   // v16.xx: the stats line scales with the title
  ctx.shadowColor='rgba(4,6,9,.95)'; ctx.shadowBlur=4;   // v18.62: the halo, for the stats line too

edits.anchor: ctx.shadowColor='transparent'; ctx.shadowBlur=0;   // v18.62: the halo ends with the stats line
edits.replacement:
ctx.shadowColor='transparent'; ctx.shadowBlur=0;   // v18.62: the halo ends with the stats line
  ctx.restore();
